title: SyncSafeCopyResponse
description: Response emitted by `sqlite-graphrag sync-safe-copy` on stdout as a single JSON line. The CLI flag accepts `--dest` (primary), `--to`, and `--output` as aliases for the destination path. Accepts `--format json` (or `--json` no-op alias) to explicitly request JSON output; JSON is always emitted by default.

truncated.description: GAP-SG-142: raised by the agent-native surface whenever it removed data from this envelope.

count.description: GAP-SG-142: emitted under --count-only, which replaces the payload. See agent-surface.schema.json#/$defs/CountOnlyEnvelope.
